               NYSE Euronext Announces its 2010 Holiday Calendar
                and Early Closing Dates for its European Markets

14 October 2009 – NYSE Euronext (NYX) today announced the 2010 holiday calendar
and early closing dates for its European markets.

NYSE Euronext’s European Cash and Derivatives markets will be open Monday to
Friday throughout 2010 except on the following days:

        - Friday 1 January 2010 (New Year's Day)
        - Friday 2 April 2010 (Good Friday)
        - Monday 5 April 2010 (Easter Monday)

On Friday 24 December 2010 and Friday 31 December 2010, cash markets will close at
1.00 pm GMT (2.00 pm CET) whilst NYSE Liffe will commence the closing of its
derivatives contracts from midday GMT (1.00 pm CET). On these days, it is NYSE
Liffe's intention to align its trading hours with those of the relevant underlying cash
markets.

On 3 May, 31 May, 30 August, 27 December and 28 December 2010, which are public
holidays in the United Kingdom, it is anticipated that NYSE Liffe’s sterling-based
products and UK-based commodity products will not be made available for trading, but
other products will be available.

As some other markets have not yet published their trading schedules for next year,
more detailed information on the trading of relevant NYSE Liffe derivatives contracts
will be published in due course.

About NYSE Euronext
NYSE Euronext (NYX) is a leading global operator of financial markets and provider of innovative trading
technologies. The company's exchanges in Europe and the United States trade equities, futures, options, fixed-income
and exchange-traded products. With more than 8,000 listed issues, NYSE Euronext's equities markets -- the New
York Stock Exchange, NYSE Euronext, NYSE Amex and NYSE Alternext as well as NYSE Arca – represent nearly
40 percent of the world's equities trading, the most liquidity of any global exchange group. NYSE Euronext also
operates NYSE Liffe, the leading European derivatives business and the world’s second-largest derivatives business
by value of trading. The company offers comprehensive commercial technology, connectivity and market data
products and services through NYSE Technologies. NYSE Euronext is in the S&P 500 index, and is the only
exchange operator in the S&P 100 index and Fortune 500. For more information, please visit: http://www.nyx.com

Euronext mettra en œuvre tous les moyens raisonnables pour assurer la conformité à ces engagements. Aucun tiers ne pourra se prévaloir d’une quelconque des clauses du Contrat signé entre Euronext et l’Apporteur de Liquidité.

Deze verplichtingen voor liquiditeitsverschaffers zijn van toepassing op specifieke en afzonderlijke overeenkomsten met elke liquiditeitsverschaffer. Euronext zal redelijke inspanningen ondernemen om de naleving van deze verplichtingen te waarborgen. Geen enkele derde partij is gerechtigd een beroep te doen op welke clausule dan ook van een dergelijke overeenkomst tussen Euronext en de liquiditeitsverschaffer.

A Euronext envidará todos os esforços razoáveis para assegurar o cumprimento dessas obrigações. Euronext farà ogni ragionevole sforzo per garantire il rispetto di tali obblighi. I terzi non possono far valere alcuna disposizione del contratto di LP stipulato tra Euronext e il LP.
